goal: Welcome the visitor and visually introduce the five pirate personas, then begin the quiz.

reference_composition.layout: Wide cinematic poster, dark ship sails in center background, 5 pirate figures spread along bottom foreground, logo upper-left, AR globe upper-right, huge beige Arabic two-line title centered in top-middle, supporting copy, red start button at bottom center.
layer_order: huge pirate ship and skull sail

content.description: أجب على ٨ أسئلة واكتشف الـ Builder الذي بداخلك

characters.staging: All full-body anime pirate characters standing on a dock in one perspective plane. Center orange one closest, red/green at edges. Each uses color-specific glow only around magical objects, otherwise crisp pixel art.
characters.alt_text: خمسة قراصنة يمثلون مسارات هندسة البرمجيات والذكاء الاصطناعي وتطوير الويب وعلم البيانات والأمن السيبراني

components.brand_alignment: start in screenshot image-left; prioritize visually consistent logo+locale placement despite RTL content

components.treatment: light dark pixel drop shadow / sharp edges

components.style: thick dark-red wooden/plaque button with bevelled gold/cream pixel trim

mobile_layout.title: Center, 2 lines, clamp(34px,10vw,48px), legible over sail with soft navy scrim
mobile_layout.description: 2-3 wrapped lines, no overlap with faces
mobile_layout.characters: Use 5-character panoramic stage across roughly lower 46% of screen; allow edge figures to be partially offscreen but keep center and colored identity visually clear. On widths <360, center 3 characters and hint other tracks; never tiny unreadable sprites.
mobile_layout.cta: Full-width or 85%-width, above bottom safe area, visible without scrolling on common 390x844; if viewport short, naturally scroll rather than overlap.
mobile_layout.background: Ship sail centered, sky/props cover viewport; subtle gradient for text legibility.

desktop_layout.hero_height: min(100svh,900px) with scroll if content exceeds viewport

interaction_and_states.enter: Optional gentle character entrance, reduced motion fallback.
interaction_and_states.start: Button routes /quiz after a real click; show loading state only while session initialization is pending.
interaction_and_states.locale: Display AR for Arabic; do not claim translation feature exists.

image_notes: Reference screenshot is a visual target. All content and CTA must be implemented as HTML/CSS, not baked into background.
